criteria.criterion: crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md no longer says the producer 'may' run the checks. It requires the producer to run the full `cargo test --locked` before finishing, for every change including docs, TOML and data-only ones. It names the reason: policy and config tests read tracked non-Rust files (boundary words, unlisted file kinds, defaults.toml, study model.json).
criteria.evidence: I read the diff. The old line is replaced with: 'Before you finish, run the full `cargo test --locked` for every change, even docs, TOML or data only: policy and config tests read tracked non-Rust files (boundary words, unlisted file kinds, `defaults.toml`, study `model.json`)...'. The remaining 'may' line now covers only 'the other checks the brief names'.

criteria.criterion: The prompt says a `not-run` full test result is not an acceptable finish, and that the producer must report the real result in checks_run.
criteria.evidence: The prompt says: 'Report the real result in `checks_run` under the command `cargo test --locked`. `not-run` is not an acceptable finish: Athena sends that report back once, then fails the job.'

criteria.criterion: A candidate whose producer report lists the full `cargo test --locked` as `not-run` (or lists no such check) is not sent to the verifier. The producer is re-invoked with a message explaining why, and a bounded retry count applies. Run `cargo test` and check that the new test for this gate passes.
criteria.evidence: In run.rs, `ran_full_tests` accepts only a `pass` or `fail` entry for that command. `PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS = 1`, and the re-invocation appends a 'Sent back' section that explains the reason. Three new lifecycle tests passed: a_not_run_full_test_sends_the_producer_back_once_and_then_verifies, a_producer_that_still_has_no_full_test_result_fails_before_verification, and a_report_with_no_full_test_check_is_sent_back_and_a_failing_run_is_not. They show that in a failing case the verifier is never invoked and there are exactly 2 producer runs.

criteria.criterion: A candidate whose report shows the full test run as pass or fail continues to verification as before. Run `cargo test` and check that the existing lifecycle and run tests still pass.
criteria.evidence: All 35 lifecycle tests passed, including a_request_lands_a_traceable_commit. The new test shows that a `fail` result gets 1 producer run and then reaches the verifier. All athena-core tests passed (158 passed, 1 ignored), including run_pin_tests, so the pinned study path still works.

criteria.criterion: `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy` are clean, and prompt budget tests (crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs) still pass with the longer prompt.
criteria.evidence: fmt produced no output. clippy with -D warnings finished clean. Both budgets tests passed. The producer budget was raised from 1,100 to 1,300 to make room; D95 records this and gives the measured sizes.

criteria.criterion: Docs that describe the producer's checks (docs/design/athena-v0.md) match the new rule and the send-back behavior. The CHANGELOG records the change.
criteria.evidence: In athena-v0.md, the brief outline line now has the must-run rule. A new paragraph in App. B.2 describes the send-back, the one-retry bound, the failure before checks and verifier, and the study exemption. The budget table and the m4 row now say 1,300. These match the run.rs code. CHANGELOG has an entry under Changed, and D95 is added to decisions.md.

findings.summary: The tests do not check the content of the send-back brief.

findings.summary: The pinned-study exemption was not requested.

summary: The candidate does what was asked. The producer frame now requires the full `cargo test --locked` on every change, including docs, TOML and data-only ones, and it gives the reason. It also says `not-run` is not an acceptable finish. In `produce_and_verify` (run.rs), a report that lacks a `pass` or `fail` result for that command goes back to the producer once, with a "Sent back" section added to its brief. A second miss fails the job before checks or the verifier run. Reports showing `pass` or `fail` go on to verification as before. I ran the lifecycle tests (35 passed, including the 3 new gate tests), the budgets tests (2 passed), the athena-core tests (158 passed, 1 ignored), and `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -D warnings`, which were both clean. The design doc, decisions.md (D95) and CHANGELOG are updated. There are two minor scope findings. First, the change edits a test helper that is not on the deliverables list. Second, it raises the producer prompt budget from 1,100 to 1,300 tokens in a file that is also not on the list. The budget rise is documented and justified, because the study producer set was already at 1,097 of 1,100 tokens. Separately, the tests do not check what the send-back brief says.
